# Talbiyah Haj & Umrah Service

> A Haj and Umrah travel service in Chennai, India, run for fifteen years by
> Moulavi Alhaj B. Mohamed Sadath. Visa, ticketing, passport, packages, group
> departures and guided ziyarat are handled from one office, and the guide
> travels with the group rather than seeing it off at the airport.

## What this business is

Talbiyah Haj & Umrah Service arranges pilgrimages from Chennai to Makkah and
Madinah. It is a single-office operation, not a booking portal: the same person
who prepares the paperwork accompanies the pilgrims on the journey.

- **Name:** Talbiyah Haj & Umrah Service
- **Tagline:** Your Journey is Our Responsibility
- **Founded:** operating for 15 years
- **Address:** No.7, 13/1, Qaide Millath Street, Chennai 600 029, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Phone and WhatsApp:** +91 97100 92070

## Who runs it

**Moulavi Alhaj B. Mohamed Sadath, Manbayee** — proprietor and Umra Guide.
Imam of Khurasani Peer Masjid (K.P.M.) on LB Road, Adyar, Chennai, where he can
also be met. He has arranged and personally accompanied Haj and Umrah groups
from Chennai for fifteen years.

## Services

- **Umrah and Haj visa** — application prepared, filed and tracked
- **Air ticketing** — fares from Chennai, issued with the group
- **Passport assistance** — new applications, renewals, corrections, re-issue
- **Haj and Umrah packages** — flights, hotels, transfers, ziyarat and guidance in one price
- **Group departures** — scheduled groups travelling together, guide on the same flight
- **Guided ziyarat** — the sites of Makkah and Madinah, explained, at an unhurried pace

## Current offer: Hajj 2027

Approved and recognised by the Government of India and the Kingdom of Saudi
Arabia. Accommodation is Makkah Clock Tower or similar, Madinah Nusuk Al Madina
or similar, and Azizya Apartment near to Jamarat.

| Package  | Price (per person) | Duration                  |

All prices exclude GST and TCS. Every package includes comfortable stay,
transport services, meals arrangements, an experienced team, visa assistance
and 24/7 support.

## Common questions

**How much does Haj cost from Chennai?**
Talbiyah's Hajj 2027 packages run from ₹6,75,000 for the 22–25 day Short
package to ₹8,00,000 for the Deluxe package, plus GST and TCS.

**How long does an Umrah visa take?**
Usually a few working days once the documents are complete. Delays almost
always come from an incomplete file — a passport too close to expiry, or
photographs that do not meet the specification. Haj runs on an annual
application window through the Haj Committee of India and approved organisers,
so it must be planned months ahead.

**What documents are needed?**
A passport valid at least six months beyond the travel date, recent colour
photographs to the required specification, and a meningitis (ACWY) vaccination
certificate. Proof of relationship may be needed for family members.

**Can women travel without a mahram?**
Saudi requirements have changed in recent years and women now travel for Umrah
in circumstances not previously permitted, often as part of an organised group.
Because the rules are revised from time to time and the fiqh position matters
as much as the visa rule, Talbiyah answers this for each specific situation
rather than publishing a blanket answer.

**Group departure or a private trip?**
A group departure costs less, travels on a fixed date, and means never
navigating alone. A private booking allows your own dates, hotel and pace, and
suits families with very young children, elderly parents or particular medical
needs. First-time pilgrims are usually better served by the group.
